title: Notification ownership and foreground disclosure promotion
minimumPromotionPolicy: Notification promotion requires owned live post/cancel evidence, packaged post/cancel/cancelAll archives, foreground disclosure, stop action, Android permission matrix, rollback cleanup, Safe downgrade, advanced notification boundary decisions, security, TypeScript declarations, docs, and raw-object denial coverage before notification authority can be marked promoted.

ownershipContract.ownedIdPolicy: provider-owned notification ids are ResourceRegistry backed; cancel only closes active owned records and unknown ids are no-op
ownershipContract.updatePolicy: notify with an existing owned id releases the old record before registering the replacement
ownershipContract.destroyPolicy: provider destroy closes owned notification handles and cancels active records

appliesTo: scheduled/background Node tasks that rely on notification visibility
notification stop action for user-owned cancellation

evidenceMatrix.requiredEvidence: Live provider posts or reports POST_NOTIFICATIONS denial, registers a NOTIFICATION resource, cancel removes it, and provider destroy closes active owned records.
getPermissionStatus and openSettings return JSON-safe permission/status snapshots, with dry-run support for automated tests.
notifications and notifications.settings capabilities reject before bridge dispatch when missing.
Packaged APK post/cancel/cancelAll smoke with package identity ownership, notification permission state, relaunch, task removal, and Safe downgrade evidence.
User-visible disclosure and stop action evidence for packaged or long-running notification-backed Node work.
Android 12 and Android 15+ permission-denied/granted matrix covering POST_NOTIFICATIONS, disabled notifications, settings round-trip, and denial copy.
Explicit stable-denial or promotion decision for actions, groups, styles, inline replies, listener callbacks, RemoteViews, and DND mutation.
Rollback cleanup archive proving owned notification ids, channels, foreground disclosure metadata, and packaged downgrade behavior are cleaned without touching external notifications.

readyEvidence.meaning: P14-22 imports owned live post/cancel, permission/settings handoff, manifest denial, and raw-object denial evidence while keeping packaged notification archives open.
P15-16 keeps packaged broadcast and task/device foreground disclosure dependencies unpromoted.
The notifications provider remains provider_poc until implementation, device, packaged, disclosure, rollback, security, type, docs, Safe downgrade, and raw-object denial evidence all pass.
The notifications provider declares disable flags, diagnostics, foreground notification ownership, stop actions, packaged downgrade behavior, and Safe downgrade requirements.
P15-17 owns P14-22 under pro.tasks_device_media with foreground_disclosure_archive evidence.

openBlockers.requiredEvidence: Packaged APK post/cancel/cancelAll archive proving package identity ownership, notification permission handling, relaunch, task removal cleanup, and Safe downgrade behavior.
Foreground disclosure and stop-action archive for ongoing packaged notifications and long-running or scheduled Node work.
Android 12 and Android 15+ permission-denied/granted matrix covering POST_NOTIFICATIONS, disabled app notifications, settings round-trip, and denial copy.
Stable-denial or promotion archive for notification actions, groups, styles, inline reply, remote input, listeners, RemoteViews, and DND mutation.
Rollback cleanup archive proving owned notification ids, channels, foreground disclosure metadata, and packaged downgrade behavior are cleaned without touching external notifications.
Provider-disable Safe downgrade proof that package-owned notifications are cancelled and future packaged disclosure metadata is disabled.
Security regression coverage proving raw Notification, NotificationChannel, PendingIntent, RemoteViews, StatusBarNotification, listener handle, Context, Intent, and Java objects remain denied.
P15-22, P15-23, P15-25, and P15-26 sync before notification ownership can be marked promoted.
